description: An unnamed (transparent) `if`'s own `then:` child `s` writes straight into the enclosing container's namespace -- a bare {{s.value}} reaches it the same way the dotted {{prime.s.value}} form does, both from the document root and from a nested dynamic `d`. Fails (renders empty) on main, where neither the root's nor `d`'s own effect names ever counted a transparent `if`'s own children.
